prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Two Column Path Choice View: Redesign the choose_path screen into a two-column layout contrasting quick companion selection directly against custom photo creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "body": "Select a ready-to-adopt companion or design a custom pet from your photos."}}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Centered Account Authentication Layout: Redesign the sign-in screen to a clean centered layout emphasizing account synchronization and direct single-click login options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet Companion", "body": "Connect your account so your pet profile and desktop data stay safely synced."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Checklist Adoption Certificate Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a structured checklist layout confirming pet details and companion verification.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Confirm Pet Adoption Details", "body": "Review your companion details and confirm official registration."}}
3: [home, redesign] Split Waiting View Layout: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout placing asset generation status side-by-side with desktop rendering status.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival", "body": "We are generating and loading your pet companion files now.", "show_progress": true}}
4: [finish, redesign] Card Layout Home Intro Overview: Redesign the home_intro screen into a card layout highlighting essential controls to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Active", "body": "Your companion is live on your desktop. Learn how to interact with it below."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Direct Journey Selection Headline Copy: Update the story screen copy to clearly outline the difference between quick adoption and custom generation before choosing.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Adopt a pre-made pet in seconds or create a custom companion from your photos.", "button_label": "Start Setup"}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Add a prominent hint below sign-in options reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to sync existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use the same sign-in provider you used previously to restore existing pets."}}
7: [adoption, copy] Upload Photo Clarity Guidelines Copy: Rewrite upload_photos text with explicit tips on lighting and angles to ensure accurate pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "Use well-lit, front-facing photos of your pet for best custom 3D generation results.", "hint": "Avoid blurry pictures or extreme angles for optimal accuracy."}}
8: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Stage Progress Indicator: Enable step counter and estimated time display on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Generating Your Pet Assets"}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Copy: Update home_intro headline and body text to clearly explain how to right-click, move, or hide the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop to open settings, chat, or temporarily hide it.", "button_label": "Launch Companion"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign retains both adoption and custom creation paths as required.
Sign-in layout redesign preserves the required account authentication function.
Replacing the adoption certificate with a checklist removes the required official stamp display.
Split waiting view maintains the job of showing that the pet is being created.
Home intro redesign remains within onboarding scope and keeps core functionality.
Story screen copy update effectively introduces the companion options.
Adding a helpful sign-in hint does not violate any onboarding rules.
Copy updates on photo upload page provide helpful guidelines without changing pricing or data requests.
Time estimate and step counter on waiting screen reflect a real wait period during asset generation.
Home intro copy update accurately introduces desktop pet interaction controls.
